name: Reaper's Almanac
text:
Whenever you sacrifice a permanent, put a harvest counter on Reaper's Almanac.
At the beginning of your end step, if you sacrificed two or more permanents this turn, put a harvest counter on Reaper's Almanac.
Remove three harvest counters from Reaper's Almanac: Choose one —
• Create a Food token, a Clue token, and a Treasure token.
• Return target permanent card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
• Target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of harvest counters on Reaper's Almanac.
